game: Ori and the Blind Forest: Definitive Edition
area: Sunken Glades with the Spirit Caverns, from the start through the Wall Jump tree to the Spirit Tree and the way out to the Hollow Grove
sources: Ori DE randomizer logic bf-areas.ori (sparkle-preference/ori_rando_server seedbuilder/areas.ori): pickup and anchor coordinates in game units

In-game world map tiles used by the rando tracker: https://ori-tracker.firebaseapp.com/images/ori-map/7/{x}/{y}.png, georeferenced with ori_rando_server map/src/shared_map.js getMapCrs (8.77 map px per unit)
Decompiled Assembly-CSharp.dll from sigmasin/OriDERandomizer (code defaults: camera DefaultZoom 20, FieldOfView 60, SeinJump heights, Spirit Flame range)
Ori fandom wiki (Sunken Glades, Enemies of Nibel, Life Cell, Spirit Light Container) via api.php
Speed Demos Archive Ori/Skills_and_Abilities (via the Wayback Machine): Spirit Flame 2 damage
TASVideos forum post 441231: Ori speeds in units/s
Walkthroughs: ludo.guide sunken-glades, gamerwalkthroughs.com sunken-glades (order of play, enemy groups; low confidence)

units.native: unity units (y up in the game; here y down)
units.how: camera code defaults from the decompiled Assembly-CSharp: perspective camera, FieldOfView 60 deg (CameraController), DefaultZoom 20 u (CameraOffsetController) => view height 2*20*tan(30) = 23.09 u, width 41.06 u at 16:9 = 1920 px. Scenes can override the zoom (CameraOffsetZone / scene default zoom); not checked against the game files.

hero.boxSrc: estimate: TAS convention says 1 unit = hitbox width; height guessed from sprite proportions
hero.runSrc: mined: TASVideos (airborne max speed ~11.67 u/s; ground run assumed equal)
hero.jumpSrc: files-equivalent: SeinJump.FirstJumpHeight = 3 (decompiled Assembly-CSharp, code default; second/third chained jumps 3.75/4.5 u)
hero.attack: Spirit Flame 2 damage per hit, 0.2 s between shots, 2 shots then 0.5 s cooldown (SDA wiki); auto-targets within 8 u (SeinStandardSpiritFlameAbility.SpiritFlameRange)
startAbilities: swim (but the Glades water is polluted and hurts until the Ginso Tree is cleansed, hours later)
Soul Link: place a save anywhere for 1 energy (needs energy cell 1, found at ~minute 2)
